title: ContextCacheEntry
description: A single entry in the AI-SE OS three-layer context cache. Produced exclusively by Cache Intelligence.

layer.description: Which of the three cache layers this entry belongs to

content_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical UTF-8 byte representation of the cached content

source_version_hashes.description: Map of artifact_id to source version hash at the time of caching. Used for divergence detection.

sensitivity_class.description: Inherited from the most restrictive source artifact in this entry

token_count.description: Estimated token count of the cached content

invalidation_condition.description: What triggers invalidation of this entry

ttl_seconds.description: Null means content-addressed invalidation only; integer means additional time-based expiry

compaction_sequence.description: For history layer only: the compaction sequence number
